# Credit request authority — source only

UNRUN. No source-job admission, tests, build, database migration or live approval has been performed for these bytes.

`captured-catalog.json` preserves the read-only September 15 03:51:33.571069 UTC credit-request catalog. `captured-name-catalog.json` preserves the 03:54:19.998512 UTC display-name dependency. No customer rows are included. The table has twelve captured columns, one primary key, four policies, one trigger and no foreign keys; no additional constraints were fabricated.

Load `captured-preimages.sql` after the existing full-weekly-accounting schema/access and supplemental baseline inputs, before the complete candidate. This adds the actual missing table and its grants/policies/trigger and preserves the exact captured original admin, request-notification and display-name definitions/ACLs. The original admin is deliberately still the pre-150500 definition; candidate component 150500 must replace it before 164600. Existing full catalog provides `fn_arena_name(text,text,text,text,text,text)` (MD5 `2b7a84c23987cb7c923dde302f9ea998`), `fn_raise_notification(uuid,text,text,text,text,jsonb)`, profiles, agents, club membership, credit assignments and notification/outbox dependencies. This source closure has not been replayed or qualified.

Component 164600:

- Uses the existing `agent-agreement:<club>` lock, then the request row lock, and calls `fn_admin_update_agent` for the exact requester user and club. No direct credit-limit implementation is added.
- Requires current authenticated actor and the expected actor carried by the originating UI intent. The supplied actor is a switch fence, never authorization.
- Makes pending approval/denial/cancellation one transaction. Approval must produce the expected canonical admin response; failure raises and rolls back.
- Returns stored requested/approved decimals as strings in both new and replay receipts. Client amounts must have exact decimal cents and survive both JSON-number and two-place display roundtrips before they become numbers. Values such as `90071992547409.90` and `.91` are refused rather than rounded. Explicit approved amounts are transmitted as validated decimal strings; omitted amounts retain server defaults, and zero is never substituted. An informational requested amount of exactly zero remains readable/cancellable under the captured legacy schema; approved limits must be positive.
- Stamps nullable `decision_authority_version=1` only for new atomic decisions. Existing terminal rows remain unverified and cannot certify replay. A matching new-authority replay returns the saved request without calling the admin writer, changing a later credit limit, or sending a new notice.
- Revokes independent update/delete/truncate/trigger privileges, removes only the captured manager UPDATE policy and rejects insertion of fabricated review state. Existing INSERT/read policies remain. A private INSERT-only definer trigger binds the requester to non-null `auth.uid()`, requires positive finite cents, exactly one requester agent in the requested club, and a different, profile-backed current club owner or active/approved owner/co-owner/admin as approver. Definer execution permits validation of upline memberships hidden by the requester's roster RLS without widening roster access. Its direct EXECUTE privileges are revoked and pre-existing definitions are refused. The separate INVOKER decision trigger retains its `current_user` fence. Service-role creation without an authenticated requester is refused; super agents gain no review authority.
- Makes request creation and every decision notification mandatory, verifies a surviving exact recipient/request/type/content/link row, and shares the existing notification/outbox transaction. Request creation notifies the approver; approval/denial notifies the requester; cancellation notifies each distinct requester/approver once. A failed or suppressed notice aborts the whole creation/decision. Credit changes are not chip payments and do not create fake paid invoices. Approver links target the registered club-scoped credit admin inbox; requester links target that club's agent dashboard. Amount text has no fixed-width formatting overflow.

Protected acceptance must run `regression.sql` as postgres against an isolated actual PostgreSQL 17 catalog after the complete candidate. It switches to the actual authenticated role for public entrypoints and direct-write refusals. Synthetic setup alone uses replica mode; actual decisions and notification failure probes use origin triggers. The outer transaction rolls back all fixture data.

Cases cover requester creation/read, forbidden pre-approved/version-stamped insertion, invalid new amounts and approvers, creation addressed to active non-owner admins and approved co-owners outside the requester's visible roster, suspended-recipient and null-auth service refusals, private trigger ACL/configuration, canonical owner approval, zero and fractional-cent rejection, below-drawn-limit refusal, same decision replay after a later independent limit change, differing replay refusal, unverified legacy terminal refusal without any rewrite, wrong expected actor, suspended manager/other-club owner/super-agent refusal, denial and cancellation, raised/suppressed creation and approval notices, and failure of the second cancellation notice after the first was inserted. The same user has an untouched agent account in another club. Approval/cancellation replay, legacy/conflicting review refusal and each notification failure compare complete before/after rows across twenty credit, agreement-history, notification/outbox and accounting/delivery tables, preserving all IDs and fields, including the authority version. Sequences are deliberately outside row equivalence: PostgreSQL sequence allocation is not transactional, and gaps are not financial writes. No application-defined stub replaces the admin writer or notification trigger under test.

`tests/unit/CreditRequestAuthority.test.ts` supplies service receipt, invalid/inexact amount, network uncertainty and account generation cases. It covers A→B and A→B→A while RPC or creation is pending, and a switch during profile-name lookup. A stale receipt must not be returned or emit CREDIT_UPDATED. Creation validates current actor, required club/approver, positive cents and the exact returned pending row, using the original INSERT trigger. Approver/requester readers accept an optional club filter applied before ordering/limit, request monetary columns as text, and reject amounts that cannot be represented exactly. Optional filters preserve existing call signatures. Widget account-generation guards remain a separate integration responsibility; these readers do not claim full-result pagination or independent account-freshness fencing.

`getPendingForClub(clubId, expectedActorId)` uses existing read policies and club/pending filters, with no old-addressee filter, so a current authorized manager can find legacy pending requests addressed to a former owner or non-manager parent. It validates the response scope, exact monetary strings and identity generation around both reads; it does not grant management authority or rewrite old recipients. Server review still checks the current manager. The fixture does not establish full-result pagination.

The older `CreditService.requestCreditIncrease` path resolves the exact current club owner, refuses missing/self/ambiguous ownership and mismatched accounts, then delegates to `creditRequestService.submitRequest`. It no longer has a direct insert route. It fences canonical actor/generation around account lookup, owner lookup and creation; `tests/unit/CreditRequestLegacyCaller.test.ts` covers this delegation and stale-account refusals. Its review path delegates to the same atomic review authority.

The complete candidate rejection phase should alter the original `fn_notify_credit_request()` configuration before activation; expected error is exactly `credit_request_notification_preimage_changed`. Because 164600 is last, all preceding component DDL must roll back too. Root owns integration into the runner, fixture hashes and accepted-authority inventory.

Concurrent duplicate approval and approval-versus-cancel, independent admin update versus decision, and manager-role change timing still require admitted two-session qualification. The source uses the established shared club lock and a locked pending status for decisions. That lock does not serialize every captured direct staff-role or club-owner writer, so this component does not establish universal authorization serialization; no such writer is expanded here. This is not a concurrency pass. No historical request is upgraded or repaired automatically.
